modWhy.creatures: A large set of new creatures, without rewriting the rest of the game.
modWhy.map: A whole map of its own, with its own biomes. Use it as the map rather than as a mod.
modWhy.overhaul: An overhaul: new creatures, rebalanced stats, its own progression. Several gigabytes, and it changes the game.
modWhy.colors: Far more colors on wild creatures, and babies for species that had none.
modWhy.death: Find where you died and what you were carrying, instead of losing an evening to it.
modWhy.flyers: Gives flyers their speed levelling back, the way it worked before it was taken out.
modWhy.stats: Look at anything and see its level, stats and torpor. The one mod every server ends up with.
modWhy.tame: Points at a tame you have left somewhere on the map.
modWhy.building: Snap points that work, pick-up without a timer, and pipes and wires that hide. The building mod.
modWhy.taming: Tame by feeding and bonding rather than by knocking everything out.
modWhy.teleport: Teleport pads between bases. What most servers use instead of raising flyer speed.
modWhy.community: The same idea, kept up by the community. Pick one of the two, not both.
modWhy.gear: Turn spare gear into better gear, so a bad drop is not simply thrown away.

crash.config: The settings on disk were written by a newer Minecraft than this server now runs, and it cannot read them. Setting them aside lets the server write its own again.
crash.newerWorld: One of the worlds on this server was saved by a newer Minecraft than it now runs, and the server stops rather than damage it. Remove that world, or put the server back on the release it was made with.
crash.worldLocked: The server is not allowed to write into its own world folder, so it cannot claim the world.
crash.portTaken: Something else already holds the port this server was given.
crash.memory: The server ran out of memory for what it has been asked to load. Give it a larger heap or install less.

lib.consolePasswordRule: 12 to 64 letters and digits, and nothing else
lib.reasonRule: One line, and no double quotes - the game console cannot carry them.
lib.resourceUrlRule: A https link ending in .zip, .tar.gz or .tgz - the release file, not the page.
lib.unknownName: The game does not know that name. Check the spelling, or turn Mojang authentication off if this server is for cracked clients.
lib.whitelistNotUnderstood: This server did not understand the whitelist command.
lib.playerListUnread: Polaris could not read this server's player list just now, and will not write over a list it cannot see. Try again in a moment.
lib.listNotReloaded: The server did not reload its list, so it will pick this up the next time it starts.
lib.notAccepted: The server did not accept that
lib.ruleMissing: This server's version does not have this rule.
lib.noBackupsToTake: This server has no backups to take
lib.spigotPaid: Paid on SpigotMC, so it has to be downloaded by hand
lib.spigotExternal: Hosted somewhere else, so it has to be downloaded by hand
lib.teleportsNoLog: Teleports are not checked: the server log cannot be read

run.backupFolder: Could not create the backup folder
run.unpackStaged: Could not unpack the staged archive
run.clearRestore: Could not clear the restore folder
run.createRestore: Could not create the restore folder
run.noWorldInBackup: The backup does not hold a world
run.worldsFolder: Could not create the worlds folder
run.placeWorld: Could not put the world in place
run.newWorld: Could not create the new world
run.asideConfig: Could not set the old config aside
run.asideWorlds: Could not set the old worlds aside
run.asidePlugins: Could not set the old plugins aside

trim.javaOnly: Only a Java server keeps its world in the files this reads
trim.stopFirst: The server has to be stopped before its world can be optimized
trim.failed: The world could not be optimized
trim.needsNewer: This machine needs a newer Polaris before it can optimize a world
trim.nothing: Nothing to take out - every chunk has been visited.
trim.wouldFree: {count, plural, one {1 chunk has} other {{count, number} chunks have}} never been visited. Removing them would free {size}.
trim.freed: Removed {count, plural, one {1 chunk} other {{count, number} chunks}} nobody had been in, freeing {size}.

lib.noAnswerInTime: The server did not answer in time
lib.fivemStarting: The server is starting. It loads its resources first, which takes a moment.
lib.backupInterrupted: The backup was still running when the server had to stop
lib.giveJarUrl: Give the URL of the server jar
lib.modpackRule: That is a modpack short name, or the link to its page
lib.jarRule: That is an https link ending in .jar

schedule.none: No schedule. The server stays as you leave it.
schedule.idle: Right now: stopped once nobody has played for {minutes} minutes.

lib.teleportsNoAdminLog: Teleports are not checked: this server does not log what operators run (the logAdminCommands game rule is off), so an operator's teleport cannot be told apart
lib.teleportsUnknownAdminLog: Teleports are not checked: this server did not say whether it logs what operators run (the logAdminCommands game rule)

arrives.stacks: Arrives as {count, plural, one {a stack of {size}} other {# stacks of {size}}}.
arrives.stacksAndRest: Arrives as {count, plural, one {a stack of {size}} other {# stacks of {size}}} and {rest}.

memory.reason: {cost, select, mods {a mod loader, } plugins {a plugin server, } other {}}{mods, plural, =0 {} one {# mod, } other {# mods, }}{players, plural, one {one player at a time} other {# players at a time}}
memory.changed: Memory went from {from} to {to} for {reason}. It applies at the next restart.
memory.changedRestarted: Memory went from {from} to {to} for {reason}. The restart applies it.

lib.noRoom: There is not enough room beside the world to copy it - {free} free, and the world is {size}. Delete a backup or two, or lower how many are kept.

move.unreadable: That stack carries data Polaris cannot write back exactly, so moving it would strip it. Give the item again instead.
move.tooLong: That stack carries more data than one command can hold, so it cannot be moved without losing some.
move.moved: They moved that stack while you were dragging it. The slot was left alone.
move.gone: That slot is empty now. The slot was left alone.
move.unsupported: This server is older than the command that moves an item into a slot (Minecraft 1.17).
move.occupied: Drop part of a stack on an empty slot or on the same item. Splitting onto something else is not something the game does.
move.indivisible: That stack carries its own data, so the items in it are not interchangeable and cannot be split.
move.recipient: The other player has to be on the server to receive it. Nothing was moved.
move.same: Pick a different player to send it to.

survival.name: Survival
survival.summary: The ordinary game. Nothing added beyond the protection every server gets.

creative.name: Creative
creative.summary: Everything unlocked and nothing to survive, for building together.

skyblock.name: Skyblock
skyblock.summary: Islands in the void, one block at a time. Installs IridiumSkyblock.
skyblock.setup: The island worlds are the plugin's own and it creates them on its first start. The world the server generates is only the lobby people land in.

parkour.name: Infinite parkour
parkour.summary: A course that generates as you run it, with times to beat. Installs InfiniteParkour.
parkour.setup: Run /parkour in game to start a course. The world the server generates is the lobby; the courses are generated as they are run.

bedwars.name: Bed wars
bedwars.summary: Teams, beds and a lot of shouting. Installs BedWars1058.
bedwars.setup: BedWars1058 ships no arenas, so until you add one the server is a lobby and nothing else. Take a ready-made map below, or build one and register it, then players join with /bw join.

luckyblock.name: Lucky blocks
luckyblock.summary: Break a block, take what it gives you, hope it was not the bad one.
luckyblock.setup: The lucky blocks are in the map, so without one this is an empty world in adventure mode.

shrinking-world.name: Shrinking world
shrinking-world.summary: A border that keeps moving, so nobody settles down. Installs DynamicWorldBorder.
shrinking-world.setup: The border moves on the schedule in the plugin's config, and /dwb on and /dwb off stop and start it.

skyblock-2-1.summary: The original island in the void, a tree and a chest. Survive on what you can make of it.
skyblock-2-1.setup: Everyone starts on the same island. The challenge list is in the chest.

parkour-spiral.summary: A tower of themed courses with checkpoints, climbed from the bottom.
parkour-spiral.setup: Checkpoints are saved per player, so people can join and leave without losing the climb.

bedwars-treasure-island.summary: Eight teams, a bed each and a pirate island in the middle. Shops, generators and traps are built in.
bedwars-treasure-island.setup: Stand on a team's pad to join it and the game starts itself. Nothing to configure and no arena to register.

luckyblock-towers.summary: Race up towers of lucky blocks and take whatever they give you. Hidden chest in every tower.

vars.rank_level: Top levels, of who is on
vars.death_message: The last death, as the game said it
vars.call_max: People who could join the call
vars.call_members: Who is in the linked call
vars.unknown: '{'{name}'}' is not something Polaris can fill in
vars.fallbackTooLong: The text after | is at most {count} characters
vars.braces: A '{ }' has to hold a variable, like '{player}' or '{polaris.name | "Player"}'

notify.crashLoopBody: It restarted {count} times without starting, so it has been stopped.
notify.outOfMemoryAtLimit: It ran out at {size}, which is as far as it may go: that is its memory limit. Raise the limit under Memory, or free up memory on the machine, and restart it.
notify.outOfMemoryAtMachine: It ran out at {size}, which is as far as it may go: that is all its machine can spare. Raise the limit under Memory, or free up memory on the machine, and restart it.
notify.memoryRaisedRestarted: It ran out of memory, so its heap went from {from} to {to}. It was restarted onto it, since nobody was playing.
notify.memoryRaisedRestartFailed: It ran out of memory, so its heap went from {from} to {to}. Restarting it onto that did not go through, so it picks it up at its next restart.
notify.memoryRaisedNextRestart: It ran out of memory, so its heap went from {from} to {to}. It picks that up at its next restart.
notify.memoryRaisedFor: Its heap went from {from} to {to} for {reason}. It picks that up at its next restart.
notify.likelyCheatingBody: {reasons}. Polaris anti-cheat caught it; look at the Anti-cheat tab before deciding.
notify.xrayBody: Each one was fully enclosed in rock, where it could not be seen without X-Ray.
notify.movementTitle: {name} may be flying or teleporting on {server}
notify.movementBody: {reasons}. Nothing was done to them: look at where and when before deciding.
